_metadata.product_long_name: NASADEM Merged DEM Global 1 arc second V001
_metadata.method: Mean of NASADEM_HGT nodes whose coordinates fall inside the ADM2 polygon; slope from central-difference gradients of the 1 arc-second DEM, averaged over interior pixels with all four neighbours valid. NASADEM values below -10 m are excluded as ocean/void artefacts (no terrestrial district lies below -10 m); they are excluded, never replaced. No interpolation or estimation.
_metadata.slope_units: degrees from horizontal (also reported as percent)
_metadata.slope_area_weighting: cos(latitude), proportional to 30 m pixel area
_metadata.median_method: Area-weighted median from a 0.01-degree slope histogram; unweighted median also stored.
_metadata.terrain_caveat: Slope is a relative terrain indicator, not an absolute erosion rate. In the flat delta, small slope differences below 2 degrees matter; the share of area above 5 degrees is reported as the main erosion indicator.
